Customs

Entry Review

A detailed examination of customs entry submissions to verify the accuracy of information, classification, valuation, and compliance before goods are released.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Entry Review?

In this glossary, Entry Review refers to: A detailed examination of customs entry submissions to verify the accuracy of information, classification, valuation, and compliance before goods are released.

How is Entry Review used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Entry review detected discrepancies in declared values and triggered further customs investigation."

Why does Entry Review matter in logistics?

Entry Review matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Entry Review?

Entry Review is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Entry Review belong to?

In this glossary, Entry Review is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A detailed examination of customs entry submissions to verify the accuracy of information, classification, valuation, and compliance before goods are released.
